issues: 没有导出时长，工作台按 default 渲 150f，比源码注释的 140f 多出 10 帧死寂
引信段是浅灰平底上一枚 2px 灰边键帽，Helvetica 字形，裙边是一块平色 #6e6e6c，物件特写没有环境和体积
"亮环"实际是 14px 深灰实线圆环，读作墨圈而不是能量溢出
飞入物是灰阶骨架卡 + 灰条面板，模糊是各向同性 blur 1→5px，不沿运动方向
猛切后的键帽钉在 x464，正好压在新顶栏的 7d/30d/90d 分段控件上
changes: 补导出 KEYCAP_SMASH_CUT_DURATION = 140；25/28/46/52/58 全部时间点、3f 下沉 14px、裙边 12→3px 压扁不变
引信段换成物件特写语法：带色相深色台面（Backdrop dark + 顶光）+ 键帽下地面光池，浅色键帽在暗场里反差最大；键帽做出碟形键面、两段裙边渐变与随离台高度变虚的两层落地影
亮环改为 10→2px 浅靛发光细环（内外 glow），压到底同帧从键底溢出一团强调色光并在 16f 内衰减；轰鸣中暗角 0.35→0.6 收紧
飞入物换成出版级 Card 与命令面板（首行 Deploy to production ⌘⏎ 高亮），模糊改为 SpeedBlur 沿飞行方向的速度拖影 + 0.4→2px 景深虚化
暗→亮硬切到 FakeDashboard 亮色全景，键帽缩成 44px 嵌在搜索框左侧 16px、与搜索框同中线，切后无任何随帧属性
issuesEn: No exported duration, so the workbench rendered the 150f default, 10 frames of dead air past the 140f in the source comment
The fuse stage is a 2px grey-bordered keycap on flat light grey with Helvetica glyphs and a flat #6e6e6c skirt; an object close-up with no environment or volume
The "bright ring" was actually a 14px solid dark-grey ring, reading as an ink circle rather than spilled energy
The fly-ins were grey skeleton cards and a grey-bar panel, blurred isotropically 1→5px rather than along the motion
After the cut the keycap sat at x464, right on top of the new top bar's 7d/30d/90d segmented control
changesEn: Exported KEYCAP_SMASH_CUT_DURATION = 140; the 25/28/46/52/58 beats, 3f 14px drop and 12→3px skirt squash are unchanged

The fuse stage now uses object close-up grammar: a hue-tinted dark tabletop (dark Backdrop with top light) and a floor light pool, so the light keycap has maximum contrast; the key gets a dished face, a two-tone skirt and a two-layer ground shadow that softens with height

The ring is a 10→2px pale indigo glowing hairline (inner and outer glow); the bottom-out frame spills one accent glow from under the key that decays within 16f; the vignette tightens 0.35→0.6 during the roar
Fly-ins are publication-grade Cards plus a command palette (top row Deploy to production ⌘⏎ highlighted), blurred with SpeedBlur along the flight direction plus a 0.4→2px depth defocus
A dark-to-light hard cut lands on the light FakeDashboard, with the keycap shrunk to 44px and seated 16px left of the search field on its centre line; nothing animates after the cut
